_what: Why each feedback form exists, from first principles, and what it needs to know about a brand before it can run. A form exists for a MOMENT: someone has just had an experience only they can tell us about. Who gets it, when, and what it may not ask all follow from the brand's facts (feedback-variables.json); nothing here assumes a platform, a business model or a timing. stages.py turns this plus a brand's facts into its feedback-stages.json; a fact the brand has not given blocks the stage and says which fact.

moments.label: On the list, never bought
moments.why: They chose to hear from the brand but haven't bought: only they can say what is holding them back and what they use instead.

wait.why: after the welcome emails have made the brand's case, or the answer is about emails they haven't read yet

moments.label: Started checkout, didn't buy
moments.why: They decided to buy and stopped at the last step: only they know which doubt or friction stopped them.

wait.why: after the recovery emails have had their turn, so the form doesn't compete with them

moments.label: First order, delivered
moments.why: They have used the product for the first time: only they can say whether it did what the ads promised, and what they'd say to a friend.

wait.why: once the product has had time to do what it promises; asked earlier, the answer is a guess

moments.label: Ordered again
moments.why: They chose the brand a second time: the reason they came back is freshest the moment they reorder.

wait.why: right after the order, once the order emails are out of the way

moments.label: Active subscriber
moments.why: They let the brand charge them on repeat: only they know whether the rhythm fits and what nearly made them cancel.

wait.why: after a renewal has arrived, so the rhythm is real to them

moments.label: Refunded
moments.why: They asked for their money back: only they can say what broke between the promise and the product.

wait.why: soon, while it's fresh, but not inside the refund's own emails

moments.label: Cancelled subscription
moments.why: They stopped the subscription: only they can say why it stopped fitting.

moments.label: After a support request
moments.why: They needed help: only they can say whether the help worked and what the site should have answered first.

wait.why: after the reply, while the experience is fresh
